      • hasResponseBody

        public boolean hasResponseBody()
        Description copied from interface: Response
        Return true if the response's body has been computed by an AsyncHandler. It will return false if:
        • either the AsyncHandler.onStatusReceived(HttpResponseStatus) returned AsyncHandler.State.ABORT
        • or AsyncHandler.onHeadersReceived(HttpHeaders) returned AsyncHandler.State.ABORT
        • response body was empty
        Specified by:
        hasResponseBody in interface Response
        Returns:
        true if the response's body has been computed by an AsyncHandler to new empty bytes
